name: nucleon-word-route-divergence
description: The canonical and NF nucleon-word builders differ by a trailing per-proton letter and by their interface schedule (linear chain A-1 vs complete graph C(A,2)); the Frobenius/Markov invariant holds on every NF basis element, so the trace machinery is clean.

assertions.name: frobenius_invariant_holds_on_every_nf_basis_element
assertions.detail: worst |tr_M(b_i) - sum y chi| = 5.38941e-16 (float64 characters; the floor, not a precision claim)

assertions.name: A1_words_differ_by_exactly_one_letter
assertions.detail: canonical 11 letters, NF 12; differing multiset entries {('-h', 1): (3, 4)}

assertions.name: both_word_length_closed_forms_hold
assertions.detail: canonical = 12A-1 and NF = 11A + C(A,2) + Z on all 9 configurations

assertions.name: canonical_interfaces_are_a_linear_chain
assertions.detail: canonical interface count == A-1 at every A through 6 (corroborated by atom_braid_word_3A's own 2A+1 accounting)

assertions.name: nf_interfaces_are_the_complete_graph
assertions.detail: NF interface count == C(A,2) at every A (read from `for prev in range(k)`, not fitted)

assertions.name: the_two_schedules_are_distinct_from_A_3
assertions.detail: chain and complete graph coincide only for A <= 2, so A >= 3 is where the routes must disagree structurally

caveats: Does NOT identify a defect in either builder and does NOT say which word is the nucleon; that is a convention judgement.
CoordinationSaturation and ChainBondOrderDependence exclude these graphs AS COORDINATION LAWS for the extensive binding term. Whether either builder claims to be one is NOT established here.
A >= 2 trace comparisons are not interpretable: the canonical route is colour-weighted and compound_shift_nf has no colour at all, so those rows also measure the convention difference.
Per-element characters are float64 (chi_lambda_braid_word), used only to LOCALISE a signal 12 orders above that floor. No agreement at any digit count is claimed.
q0AnchorReason: q read at the experimental pin via q_at(); it enters the letter tags and the Markov weights. The word-length and interface results are integer combinatorics and do not move with the pin.
